messages:
maria: Heads-up: we need a quick sync on how the Console shows the *effective* project when service-account token exchanges happen. billing dashboard shows org, runtime shows origin project — customers get confused.

aj: +1, seen this in a support ticket. We should surface both origin_project and effective_project in the console, but make the primary metric be the chargeable project.

kevin: can we avoid changing billing pipelines? If we only add telemetry labels it's low-risk. propose adding a tag: `effective_project` and keep `origin_project` for tracing.

sophie: agree, but UX needs to show clear precedence. suggestion: display line `Project (charged): <effective>` and a secondary small link `origin: <origin>` that expands. low visual noise.

david: technical: token exchange path sometimes loses origin claim when we do short-lived impersonation. we should ensure the auth proxy preserves `x-origin-project` header and emit it to metrics. e.g.:
```
telemetry.emit({
  metric: 'request.count',
  tags: {
    origin_project: req.headers['x-origin-project'] || 'unknown',
    effective_project: req.auth.effective_project || req.auth.project_id || 'system'
  }
})
```

maria: that snippet looks good. also we need to decide sample rates — sending origin_project for every request will increase cardinality. maybe 1% full-cardinality + 100% aggregated counts.

aj: 1% high-cardinality sampling + 100% low-cardinality prefix bucketing sounds right. sampling flag behind feature-flag `auth.origin_cardinality_sampling`.

kevin: telemetry pipeline note: we already have per-key quota metrics named `quota.consumed.tokens`. if we add effective_project tag, billing joins become straightforward. but we must update billing ETL to prefer `effective_project` when present.

sophie: UX rollout plan: 1) add labels in Console behind a feature flag for internal beta. 2) add a toggle in the billing view for ops to switch attribution fallback to origin for 30d. 3) open comms to accounts team.

infra-bot: deploy: telemetry-service v2.14.0 promoted to staging (build 9a3d).

david: one more edgecase — delegated service-accounts (cross-org) appear as `system` in some legacy flows. will add a join key `delegation_chain` to help debugging but keep it sampled.

maria: To-dos: (1) kevin update telemetry schema + ETL ticket, (2) aj add sampling FF + config, (3) sophie mockup Console small text, (4) david ensure x-origin preserved through proxy. I'll run the internal beta next Tue.

aj: I'll make a tiny PR for the sampling FF and the telemetry tag change, link here when ready. :thumbsup:

kevin: i'll open ETL PR and add migration note for billing.

sophie: will share mockups by EOD tomorrow.

maria: thanks all. if anything blocks the proxy change ping me directly.
